examples.title: Banner variants
examples.description: All four semantic variant styles — info, success, warning, and danger.
examples.code: Your trial expires in 7 days. Your changes have been saved successfully. Storage is 90% full. Free up space soon. Your payment method has expired.

examples.title: Unreachable preset
examples.description: The server is down: the preset writes the sentence, the absolute as-of time, the countdown and Retry now.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Banner } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let loadedAt = new Date(Date.now() - 120_000);
  let seconds = $state(4);
</script>

<Banner
  preset="unreachable"
  dataUpdatedAt={loadedAt}
  retryInSeconds={seconds}
  attempt={3}
  onRetry={() => (seconds = 4)}
/>

examples.title: Title and actions
examples.description: A warning banner with a bold title, a line of detail and two secondary actions.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Banner, Button } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<Banner variant="warning" dismissible={false} title="1 change waits for a restart">
  Workflow claim renew interval. Running work picks up where it stopped; reviews stay waiting.
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" label="Revert 1 change" />
    <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" label="Restart now" />
  {/snippet}
</Banner>

examples.title: Neutral banner
examples.description: The neutral variant for a page-wide note that is not a warning or a success: a stacked bold title over the sentence, with no status colour.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Banner } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<Banner variant="neutral" dismissible={false} title="This agent has no memory yet">
  Memory is written when the agent learns a fact about you. Nothing has been written.
</Banner>

examples.title: Feature banner
examples.description: An announcement with glyph art, an indigo wash, a bold title, one muted line and trailing actions. It is a labelled region, not a status, and below 560px of its own width the actions drop under the words.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Banner, Button } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import Sparkles from '@lucide/svelte/icons/sparkles';
</script>

<Banner variant="feature" title="Plan a night out with friends">
  Pick three bars and share one link; everyone votes before you go.
  {#snippet art()}
    <Sparkles aria-hidden="true" />
  {/snippet}
  {#snippet actions()}
    <Button variant="primary" size="sm" label="Start a plan" />
    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" label="Not now" />
  {/snippet}
</Banner>
